heroTitle: When Paying for Long‑Term Care Feels Unclear
heroLines: Medicaid, Medicare, and long-term care decisions are complex.
This resource helps families understand their options—one step at a time.
startLine: Start anywhere. Learn at your own pace.

tiles.title: Medicare Is Ending — What Happens Next?
tiles.subtitle: Understanding what changes—and why planning matters.

tiles.title: Do We Have to Spend Everything?
tiles.subtitle: Why Medicaid planning is often about structure, not less.

tiles.title: What If We Have Too Much Income?
tiles.subtitle: Why income is usually not the barrier people think it is.

tiles.title: Do We Actually Qualify Medically?
tiles.subtitle: Why eligibility involves more than finances.

tiles.title: Do We Have to Sell the Home?
tiles.subtitle: Why the home is often treated differently under Medicaid rules.

tiles.title: Is It Too Late to Get Help?
tiles.subtitle: Why many families still have options—even during a crisis.

whatIsBody: Medicaid Pathways is an educational resource created to help families understand how long-term care and Medicaid planning actually work.
whoBody: Medicaid Pathways is designed to help families understand their situation. When questions become more specific—or when decisions feel urgent—speaking with an experienced Medicaid planning attorney can help bring clarity.
readyBody: Medicaid Pathways is designed to help families understand their situation.
